rationale: The prompt's central requirement is public discussion feed and nested-reply browsing with visible metadata. The anchored # Instagram — Browsing Skill scopes the source-visible material to "Use when the user wants to interact with Instagram — extract a user's profile data (bio, followers, following, post count, avatar) or scrape visible posts from a user's grid (URLs, thumbnails, captions). Works on instag, which does not provide a plausible route to that central input/output boundary.
